capacity:canary.title: Orders canary is down
capacity:canary.message: It's saved down, so it handles nothing: messages sent to it fail until it's back.
capacity:canary.rationale: A service saved down or paused starts that way in live view. Behind a topic or queue its messages wait; pushed to it, they fail.
